india.title: India — Cybersecurity Interview Prep
india.market_context: The Indian cyber market is dominated by three employer types: (1) IT services giants (TCS/Infosys/Wipro/HCL/Tech Mahindra/Accenture India) — high volume, client-facing, structured lateral hiring; (2) Product companies (Google/Microsoft/Adobe/Cisco/Zscaler/Palo Alto India + Indian unicorns like Razorpay/Freshworks) — deeper technical bar, higher salary, competitive; (3) Big 4 cyber advisory (KPMG/Deloitte/EY/PwC India) — consulting track, GRC + technical mix. Salary in LPA (lakhs per annum). CTC vs in-hand distinction matters — always clarify.
process_norms: 3-5 interview rounds typical: HR screen → technical screen → deep technical → manager → HR wrap
Coding / hands-on round common at product companies (HackerRank, CoderPad)
Assignment / take-home task frequent at startups + Big 4 (2-4 hour scope)
Notice period discussion is standard — 30/60/90 days. Buy-out negotiations are common at product companies but not IT services
Reference check + BGV (background verification) is mandatory. Discrepancies on dates or titles = offer withdrawn
Offer discussion in LPA — always clarify fixed vs variable, joining bonus, retention bonus, ESOP vs stock
Location flexibility matters — many roles are hybrid, some fully in-office (mostly IT services + Big 4)
cultural_notes: Address recruiters and interviewers by first name unless they open with title (Sir/Ma'am common in older IT services firms, less at startups)
'Why leave your current role?' asked more directly — have a clear, non-negative answer prepared
Compensation negotiation is expected — first offer is rarely final. Push back with data (Levels.fyi, AmbitionBox salary ranges)
Ask about tech stack + team size upfront to filter services companies from product companies
For non-Indian citizens (you are Indian): no visa issue for India. But mention Ireland residency + your MSc from NCI as a differentiator, not a complication
salary_bands: Associate Security Engineer (1-3 yrs): ₹8-14 LPA at IT services · ₹15-25 LPA at product companies · ₹18-30 LPA at top-tier product (Google, Microsoft, AWS)
AppSec / Product Security Engineer (2-5 yrs): ₹15-25 LPA at IT services · ₹25-45 LPA at product companies · ₹40-70 LPA at top-tier
Security Analyst (0-3 yrs): ₹6-12 LPA at IT services · ₹12-20 LPA at product companies · ₹15-30 LPA at Big 4 associate level
Add 20-30% for Bangalore/Gurugram vs tier-2 cities; ESOPs meaningful only at top-tier product + funded startups
common_technical_questions: Walk me through the OWASP Top 10. Which two do you find most under-appreciated by developers?
You find an IDOR in production during grey-box testing. Walk me through your next 5 steps.
Explain SSRF + how it chains to AWS metadata credential theft. What is IMDSv2 and why does it matter?
Difference between SAST and DAST. Give one bug each catches that the other misses.
Walk through the OWASP API Security Top 10. Rank the top 3 by real-world impact.
Explain JWT algorithm confusion attack. How would you exploit and how would you fix?
You're doing a pentest and the client says 'stay in scope'. Mid-engagement you find an exposed AWS access key on GitHub. What do you do?
How would you secure a REST API from scratch — auth, rate limit, input validation, logging?
What is CSP and what are its limitations against XSS in 2026?
Explain the difference between XSS, CSRF, and clickjacking. Give one mitigation for each.
Walk me through your methodology for a web application pentest from kick-off to report.
How do you validate a critical vulnerability report from a scanner? What is your false-positive rate?
For an AppSec role: how would you introduce security into a CI/CD pipeline that has zero security controls today?
For a Product Security role: how do you threat-model a new feature during design phase?
For a Security Analyst role: walk me through your alert triage process. What do you check in the first 5 minutes?
common_behavioural_questions: Why do you want to leave your current company?
Where do you see yourself in 3-5 years?
Tell me about a critical vulnerability you found. How did you report it? What was the impact?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a developer on severity of a finding. How did it resolve?
Why India after being in Ireland? (Be direct — visa timing, family, market fit)
Are you open to relocation within India? What is your preferred base?
What is your current notice period? Can you serve less if we buy it out?

items: Set up Naukri profile with keywords: Application Security, Penetration Testing, OWASP, Burp Suite, JWT, API Security, ISO 27001
Set up LinkedIn India job alerts for all 4 target role titles (AppSec, Product Sec, Associate Security Engineer, Security Analyst) — daily digest
Apply to 30 roles per week across Naukri + LinkedIn — mix IT services (volume plays) + product companies (target plays)
Refresh Instahyre + Cutshort profiles — recruiters will approach you
Expect first HR screens to land in Week 3. Prep the standard: notice period, expected CTC, reason to leave, willingness to relocate
Technical rounds start Week 4. Drill the 15 common technical questions above out loud — record yourself, tighten the weak 3
Big 4 processes are slower — apply early Week 1, expect first-round interviews in Week 3-4
Ask for BGV requirements upfront — start collecting employment letters, education transcripts, PAN, Aadhaar copies
Manager rounds + case-based rounds land here. Focus on your Cubic Telecom + Indusface stories with STAR format
Start salary conversations with recruiters — anchor high, cite AmbitionBox + Levels.fyi data
Product company loops (Google/Microsoft/AWS/Adobe) may extend to Week 8+. Continue applying but don't over-index on these if you have a firm offer in hand
Reference-check requests start — line up 2-3 references from Cubic + Indusface who will respond quickly
Target: 1-2 firm offers in hand by Day 45
Negotiate final offer — joining bonus, notice-period buy-out, retention bonus
Serve notice + BGV in parallel — most offers give 45-60 days to join
Book flights only after signed offer letter + BGV clearance

uae.title: UAE (Dubai / Abu Dhabi) — Cybersecurity Interview Prep
uae.market_context: UAE cybersecurity market is dominated by: (1) Regional cybersecurity specialists (Help AG, CPX, Injazat) — MSSP + consulting, strong entry pathway via SOC; (2) Financial services (Emirates NBD, ADCB, FAB, Mashreq) — regulated by CBUAE, growing cyber teams; (3) Government + sovereign (Mubadala, ADNOC, Emirates Group, e& / Etisalat) — high-prestige, non-EU workforce common; (4) Big 4 cyber advisory (KPMG/Deloitte/EY/PwC ME) — consulting track; (5) Multinationals (Microsoft/AWS/Cisco/CrowdStrike/Palo Alto UAE) — smaller footprint than India but growing. Employer sponsors work visa (mandatory). Salary in AED, tax-free.
process_norms: 2-3 rounds typical — faster than India: HR screen → technical → hiring manager / final
Assignment / hands-on task uncommon (unless Big 4 or product company)
Visa + relocation logistics discussed in the second round usually — employer runs the process
Salary quoted as monthly (basic + housing + transport) or annual all-in — always clarify
Notice period at UAE employers typically 1-3 months; offer letters common practice, contracts signed on arrival
Reference checks + police clearance certificate (from India + Ireland) required for visa
cultural_notes: English is the business language across tech + cyber roles — no Arabic required for most roles
Formal but friendly tone — 'Dear' openings, sign-off with 'Kind regards' or 'Best regards'
Islamic greetings (Assalamu Alaikum) appreciated but not required — 'Good morning' is fine
Working week is Monday-Friday (changed from Sunday-Thursday in 2022). Some private companies still on Sunday-Thursday
Ramadan working hours are shorter (typically 6 hours/day); expect delayed responses during Ramadan
Emiratisation quotas apply to some roles at large employers — non-Emiratis are still hired at all levels in tech + cyber, no issue
Interviews often conducted over Teams / Zoom for first round; final round increasingly in-person after visit visa
regulatory_context_to_know: UAE IA (Information Assurance) Standards — federal cybersecurity baseline
NESA (National Electronic Security Authority) — signals + government sector oversight
ADSIC — Abu Dhabi Systems and Information Committee, government IT standards
Dubai Cybersecurity Strategy — Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) governance
CBUAE — Central Bank of UAE cybersecurity regulations for banking (parallels DORA)
DIFC + ADGM — financial free zones with their own data protection + operational resilience rules
PDPL — UAE Personal Data Protection Law (2021) — GDPR-inspired
ISO 27001 and PCI DSS widely referenced across banking + payments
salary_bands_aed_tax_free: Associate Security Engineer (1-3 yrs): AED 12,000-20,000/month (~USD 3,300-5,400) at consultancies + banks
AppSec / Product Security Engineer (2-5 yrs): AED 20,000-35,000/month at product companies + banks
Security Analyst / SOC L1-L2: AED 10,000-16,000/month (Help AG / Injazat entry tier)
Big 4 associate cyber consultant: AED 14,000-22,000/month + relocation
Add: annual return flight, health insurance, education allowance (if family), 30 days annual leave. All salaries tax-free.
common_technical_questions: Walk me through the OWASP Top 10. Which are you most familiar with?
Explain a critical vulnerability you discovered in a recent engagement. What was the impact?
How do you approach an API security assessment? Walk me through the OWASP API Top 10.
Difference between SAST and DAST — where would you use each in a CI/CD pipeline?
You're building a SOC playbook for a phishing email with a malicious attachment. Walk through the steps.
Explain the difference between IDS, IPS, and EDR. When would you deploy each?
What is Zero Trust architecture? How would you begin rolling it out at a bank?
How does OAuth 2.0 differ from OpenID Connect? Common misconfigurations you've seen?
For a bank role: how would you approach a PCI DSS assessment for a payment gateway?
For a government / critical-infra role: what is UAE IA Standards awareness? How does it compare to NIST CSF?
How would you build a threat model for a mobile banking app (Android + iOS)?
Walk me through a SOC alert triage — a Windows host beaconing to a suspicious domain.
What's your experience with cloud security (AWS / Azure)? Explain IAM least-privilege for a web app.
How would you conduct a phishing simulation? What metrics matter?
For a Product Security role: how do you build a security champions programme in engineering?
common_behavioural_questions: Why UAE / Dubai as a market? What's your long-term plan?
Are you open to relocation? What is your current visa status?
Tell me about a time you managed conflict with a stakeholder — client, developer, or manager
Describe a project where you had to influence without authority
How do you handle working across cultures? (relevant given the UAE workforce mix)
Are you available to travel across GCC (KSA, Qatar, Oman) if the role requires?
What is your current salary and expected package in AED?
How soon can you start after visa is issued?

items: Set up Bayt, Naukrigulf, GulfTalent, LinkedIn UAE profiles with matching keywords
Apply to Help AG, CPX, Injazat, e& Enterprise, Emirates NBD, ADCB, Careem, Noon in Week 1 (they move fastest)
Register with Hays Middle East + Michael Page UAE + Cooper Fitch — sponsor-aware recruiters
Prepare digital copies: passport, MSc certificate (attested for UAE), Ireland residence stamp, prior education attestation, police clearance from India + Ireland
HR screens land Week 2-3. Prep the standard: expected package in AED, notice period, visa status, willingness to relocate on X weeks
Technical rounds Week 3-4 — drill the 15 UAE-specific questions above out loud
Big 4 Middle East processes are structured but slower — apply Week 1, first round in Week 3-4
Practise regulatory context: UAE IA, NESA, PDPL, CBUAE guidelines — these come up in bank + government interviews
Manager + hiring team rounds land here. Have concrete Cubic Telecom + Indusface stories ready in STAR format
Start salary conversations — anchor with Bayt + GulfTalent + Cooper Fitch data for your role band
Visa logistics discussed in this phase. Employer typically applies for entry visa, you enter UAE on visit visa or employment visa, then convert to residence visa
Book police clearance certificates now (India + Ireland) if not already — 2-6 week turnaround
Target: 1-2 firm offers by Day 45
Negotiate final package: basic + housing + transport allowance, annual return flight, health insurance, education (if applicable), joining bonus
Sign offer letter — actual contract signed on arrival in UAE typically
Begin visa application via employer + start packing / relocation logistics in parallel
Attestation of documents (MSc + prior degrees) via UAE embassy in Ireland or India — start early, 2-3 weeks turnaround
